title.zh: Crypto projects apply for Anthropic’s new frontier AI security scanner
title.en: Crypto projects apply for Anthropic’s new frontier AI security scanner

current_state.zh: Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, an opt-in service that generates vulnerability reports for open-source projects using its strongest frontier models, prompting applications from crypto projects including Nethermind and ZEUS.
